entries.name: ext-dup-ids-05-07-05-collapse#0
entries.description: Spending-proof extension with count 3 and entries 05 -> Int 1, 07 -> Int 2, 05 -> Int 3. The JVM builds the map with values.toMap (ContextExtension.scala:65): the repeated id keeps its last value at its first position, so the tx re-serializes with 2 entries, 05 -> Int 3, 07 -> Int 2, and the JVM tx id comes from those collapsed bytes. Non-identity round-trip.

entries.name: ext-dup-ids-07-05-07-collapse#1
entries.description: The same collapse with the higher id first: 07 -> Int 1, 05 -> Int 2, 07 -> Int 3 re-serializes as 07 -> Int 3, 05 -> Int 2. An id-sorted map matches the JVM on entry #0 by coincidence, not on this one.
